title: Switch
description: A switch on bits-ui Switch, with the part name of the stock shadcn-svelte Switch, for settings that apply at once. The knob is the one moving piece: it slides on settle while the colour of the state it goes to is wiped in behind it (copper from the start, the track from the end), and holding stretches the knob toward its destination. Sizes default (52 × 32) and sm (40 × 24), both 44px to touch. In a form, with a name, it always submits: value ("on") while on, uncheckedValue ("off") while off; disabled, nothing. form.reset() puts it back to its mount state, drawn and submitted alike. bind:checked may point at an undefined value (a missing record key): it reads as off.
